_README: Copy to calibration_levels.json and write one entry per capability_unit id
in your seed_identity.json. Every capability MUST appear here — one that is
missing fails to load silently, and the criteria that needed it draw no
Scale: 1 Exposure / 2 Assisted / 3 Independent / 4 Advanced / 5 Authority.
Write the rationale honestly in BOTH directions. State what you cannot yet
do as plainly as what you can — 'independently does X; has not yet done Y'.
The limit is what makes the claim credible, and it keeps you honest in the
interview. Guard equally against overclaiming and against the self-
underestimation that stops people applying for jobs they would get.

cap_example_analysis.rationale: Independently designs and runs the analysis end to end, and decides what a dataset will support; not yet publishing methods work in its own right.

cap_example_coordination.rationale: Ran a multi-site programme of real scale — say the numbers — with full responsibility for reporting; advanced on current work alone.
